description: Procurement of vaccines for the National Immunization Programme of Sri Lanka through the UNICEF Global Supply Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Immunization Programme of Sri Lanka is working to ensure the availability of high-quality vaccines at affordable prices in line with the World Health Organization’s Expanded programme on Immunization. The programme offers vaccines to approximately 1.5 million children and 300,000 pregnant women annually to prevent 11 diseases. The Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunization has been providing support for the procurement of these vaccines since 2000. Also, the said Alliance has provided financial support to procure vaccines through the Global Supply Division of UNICEF from 2023 to 2025 through a joint procurement method. Unlike a procurement process carried out by an individual country, it is possible to procure WHO recommended and prequalified vaccines through the Global Supply Division of UNICEF at lower prices, ensuring a greater security of supply. Further, it paves the way for the continuous supply of vaccines, timely distribution of vaccines, and effective procurement practices. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to procure Immunization vaccines for the National Immunization Programme of Sri Lanka through Global Supply Division of UNICEF for the period 2026-2030, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting tax concessions for the importation of Milk fish, which is used as the bait fish for the Long Line Fishing Method
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Owners of Multiday fishing vessels use the long line fishing method to catch fish which belongs to Tuna species. Small fish such as squid, milkfish, sailfish, flying fish etc. are used as bait for the said purpose. As a method of sustainable consumption of fish resources, the fish harvested using the long line fishing method is of high quality and therefore commands a high price in the international market. About 2,200 multiday fishing vessels in the country use the long line fishing method, and about 8,000 metric tons of bait fish are annually required for the purpose. However, only about 4,000 metric tons of that amount can be supplied locally. Therefore, with the support of the private sector, it is planned to produce milkfish for bait locally in the future. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources regarding the provision of tax concession on the import of milkfish until such time the said local products could be used, the Cabinet decided to import the required milkfish through the registered fishing societies, and to introduce a special commodity levy of Rs.180/- per kilogram of imported milkfish instead of the currently implemented tariff system and to provide a tax concession of Rs.130/- from that tax to fishing societies importing milkfish, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for design and construction of the Housing project with 615 housing units at the Colombage Mawatha, Kirulapone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-30  for the initiation of the relevant procurement process to select a contractor for the design and construction of the remaining works of the Housing project with 615 housing units at the Colombage Mawatha, Kirulapone which had been suspended halfway. Accordingly, the Urban Development Authority invited bids and 04 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the relevant contract to Access Engineering PLC, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee relating to the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for investment proposals for the disposal of a land plot located at the Chatham Street, Colombo Fort on a 99 year lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although investment proposals have been called in the year 2024 for the implementation of a mixed development project on a 99-year lease basis in a plot of land in extent of 02 roods 14.7 perches, belonging to the Urban Development Authority, located at Chatham Street, Colombo, no investor has come forward for the same. Therefore, the Urban Development Authority has planned to re-invite development proposals from prospective private investors for the said plot of land with the aim of contributing to the economic development of the country through optimal use. Accordingly, based on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to invite investment proposals following the government procurement guidelines so that the said plot of land could be granted on lease basis for a period of 99 years for the implementation of a mixed development project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the design and construction of the remaining works of the Housing Project consisting of 115 housing units at the Torrington Avenue, Colombo 07.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-30 for the initiation of the procurement process to select a contractor for the design and construction of the remaining works of the Housing Project consisting of 115 housing units at the Torrington Avenue, Colombo 07, which had been suspended halfway. Accordingly, the Urban Development Authority invited bids and received 05 bids. Based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee following the evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the contract for the design and construction of the remaining works of the Housing Project consisting of 115 housing units at Torrington Avenue, Colombo 07, to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt) Ltd, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of empty LPG Cylinders without valves for Litro Gas Lanka Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Litro Gas Lanka Limited has invited international competitive bids from the registered suppliers of the Sri Lanka Standards Institution for the purchase of 04 types of empty LPG cylinders without valves for the period of 2025-2027. 06 bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee upon evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the procurement for the supply of 120,000 cylinders of 2.3 kg, 185,000 cylinders of  5 kg, 450,000 cylinders of 12.5 kg and 7,000 cylinders of 37.5 kg, for Litro Gas Company Limited, to the substantially responsive lowest bidder, M/s. Sahamitr Metal Pressure Containers Public Co. Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the remaining works of the construction project of a Multi-Ethnic and Trilingual new National School in the Polonnaruwa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2015-09-09 for the construction of a new multi-ethnic and trilingual national school in the Polonnaruwa District. Under this, it has been planned to construct 02 building complexes as Block 01 and Block 02. The construction of the Block 01 building complex was carried out under the guidance of the High Commission of India as a grant from the Government of India and the construction of the Block 02 building complex was carried out under the guidance of the then Ministry of Education with the funds of the Government of Sri Lanka. In view of the economic crisis which prevailed in the country, the construction of Block 02 building complex has been suspended and the relevant contract has been terminated. The relevant scope of Block 1 has been revised under the guidance of the High Commission of India, and after completion of the ground floor, construction has been carried out up to the roof of the upper floor and steps have been taken to hand over the said building complex to the Government of Sri Lanka on 2025-10-31. The Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, the consulting engineering firm for the project, has submitted an estimate of Rs.199.13 million for the completion of the remaining works of the Block 01 building complex. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to take necessary steps to complete the works of the said building complex based on the said estimate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Suraksha Student Insurance Programme in the year 2025/26
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education has entered into an Agreement with Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation General Limited to implement the 'Suraksha' Student Insurance Programme, being implemented with a view to facilitating students who face obstacles in their educational activities due to various health problems to continue their education. Approximately 4 million students studying in Government schools, Government-approved private schools, Pirivenas and Government assisted special schools have been provided with the opportunity to obtain benefits under the categories of health insurance, accident insurance and life insurance through the same. Taking into consideration the matters presented by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to the effect that action would be taken to implement the 'Suraksha' Student Insurance Programme during the year 2025/26 incorporating the following amendments and accordingly steps would be taken to issue the relevant Circular instructions taking into account the issues identified in the implementation of this programme, the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the same:

Implementation of the 'Suraksha' Student Insurance Programme relating to the year 2025/26, up to 2026-08-31.
Revision of the annual income of the low-income category considered in providing the benefit of parental death from Rs. 180,000/- to Rs. 240,000/-.
Providing benefits up to Rs. 75,000/- for Scoliosis Brace worn to rectify the defects in the spinal code and for cochlea equipment.
Providing benefits up to Rs. 20,000/- for students taking long-term medications for diseases under critical illness category and 07 other identified diseases.
Adding 5 new diseases to the critical illness category namely Pneumothorax, Encephalitis, Thalassemia, Hereditary spherocytosis and Sickle cell anemia.
Providing the opportunity to hand over claim applications for benefits to any Regional Office of Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation General Limited from 2025-09-01.

description: Restriction of the use of polythene and plastic in the Sri Pada highly sensitive ecological zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Pada pilgrimage season begins in December every year and lasts for 6 months, during which, a large amount of biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste, disposed of by pilgrims and other people, accumulates in the area. The Sri Pada site is a high-sensitive area covered by the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance, and waste management in the area is a timely requirement. Accordingly, upon the Minister of Environment informing the Cabinet that the Ministry of Environment would adopt the following measures from 2025 to minimize the use of polythene and plastic in the said area during the Sri Pada pilgrimage season, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the same:

Lunch sheets, containers made of high-density polyethylene (squeeze bags), sachet packets, single-use food containers made of expanded polystyrene, single-use drinking straws, straws, single-use plates, cups, spoons, forks and knives, which are made of already banned polythene, will be completely prohibited from being sold in this area or carried by pilgrims.
Prohibition of carrying single-use plastic water bottles and beverage bottles of less than 1 litre.
Prohibiting the disposal of food, beverage, medicine or other goods with polythene covers and packaging in the environmentally sensitive zone.
Assigning the responsibility of managing the waste generated after the sale of food, beverages, medicine or other merchandise with plastic covers sold by business establishments in the environmentally highly sensitive zone to the relevant shop owners.
Prohibiting the contamination of water sources and waterways and the disposal of polythene and plastic waste in those places.
Assigning the responsibility of properly collecting the polythene and plastic waste accumulated during the construction and maintenance of shops and bringing it outside the Sri Pada highly sensitive zone, to the respective shop owners for final disposal through the relevant Urban Councils or Pradeshiya Sabhas.

description: Establishment of Advisory Committees to strengthen and promote local industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- With the aim of minimizing policy issues in industrial and entrepreneurship development, 20 Advisory Committees have been established by now covering the manufacturing industry sectors. It has been identified that more Advisory Committees covering 07 specific industry sectors need to be established. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to establish Advisory Committees for the following industry sectors, consisting of not more than 25 members representing Government institutions, Chambers of Commerce/Conventions, academic institutions (universities and research institutes) and experts in the relevant industry sector, was approved by the Cabinet:

Local Ayurveda and Traditional Medicine Sectors
Confectionery - related Manufacturing Industries Sector
Traditional Handicrafts Sector
Poultry-related Industry Sector
Ornamental Fish and Seaweed-related Industry Sector
Creative Arts-related Industry Sector
Event Management Sector

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Public Enterprises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The post of Director General of the Department of Public Enterprises has now become vacant due to the retirement from the public service of Mr. P.A.S. Athula Kumara, who served in the said Post on 20251203. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint Mr. B.A.T. Rodrigo, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Accountants’ Service, presently serving as an Additional Director General of the Department, to the vacant post of Director General of the Department of Public Enterprises with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The post of Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring is currently vacant due to the appointment of Mr. S.S. Mudalige, who served as the Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring, to a Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint Mr. S.H.V. Kumara, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, presently serving in a Post of Additional Director General of the Department of Development Finance, to the said post, with immediate effect.

description: Ratification of the International Labour Organization Convention on the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The International Convention on the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work (C190), which was adopted by the International Labour Conference at its 108th session held in 2019, is considered the first international convention established in that regard. The said Convention was tabled in Parliament on 20210504 as per the Cabinet decision dated 20210324. The ratification and implementation of the Convention will have a positive impact on eliminating violence and harassment existing in private and informal workplaces, ensuring safe and happy workplaces, and increasing women's participation in the labour force. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to take necessary measures to ratify the International Convention on the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work of the International Labour Organization by Sri Lanka and to introduce legal provisions for its implementation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: e-Court project of the implementation of Digital Transformation of the Court System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the digitalization of the court system in Sri Lanka as a national priority initiative. As the initial step in the digital transformation process, the Supreme Court has successfully launched and implemented a Web Portal integrating an eCase Management System (e-CMS) by now. Through the 'e-Court' project it is anticipated that the Web Portal and e-CMS developed for the Supreme Court would be adapted and used by all courts across the island, including the Court of Appeal, the Judicial Service Commission, and the Judges’ Institute. It is planned to establish a National Judicial Data Grid, which will overcome the long-standing problems of case delays, lack of data transparency, and procedural inefficiencies that hinder timely access to justice faced by the judicial system of the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to allocate provisions amounting to Rs.150 million to the Judicial Service Commission for the implementation of the 'e Court' project from the provisions allocated under the 'Clean Sri Lanka' project effectively and efficiently, in line with the Reform Agenda of the International Monetary Fund, Public Investment Programme 2026-2030 and the 'Clean Sri Lanka' strategy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Converting the paddy purchased by the Paddy Marketing Board to rice and releasing them to the market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The paddy purchased by the Paddy Marketing Board during the last Yala season using funds of about Rs.6,000 million allocated in the 2025 budget, has already been stored in the warehouses belonging to the Paddy Marketing Board. In order to ensure a continuous supply of rice in the market, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation; and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to take necessary action to mill the said stock of paddy through the paddy mill owners registered with the Paddy Marketing Board for the year 2025 and release those to the market through the Lak Sathosa and the Cooperative network, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proceed with the Lower Malwathu Oya Multi-purpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Lower Malwathu Oya Multipurpose Development Project was initiated in 2016 with the objectives of overcoming water scarcity, which has a major impact on rural development and agricultural production in the Lower Malwathu Oya Valley, creating a new development area in the Thanthirimale area, increasing the intensity of cultivation in 30,690 acres of paddy lands, generating hydropower, and providing drinking water under the Yodha Wewa and Akithamuruppu Wewa in the Mannar District. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 20190719 for the total cost estimate of the said project, which is Rs.22,900 million. Although the construction work of the project was initiated by the Department of Irrigation, it was temporarily suspended in 2022 due to the then Covid-19 pandemic and the economic crisis, has now been resumed as per the decision of the Committee of Re-strategizing and Acceleration of Mega Development Projects (RAMP). Based on the recommendation of the Technical Evaluation Committee, the current total cost estimate of the relevant project has been calculated at Rs.47.18 billion. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to amend the revised cost estimate of the Lower Malwathu Oya Multipurpose Development Project to Rs.47.18 billion, implement the project under local funds and extend the project period up to 31 December 2030, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Co-hosting the Asian Regional Public Debt Management Forum 2026 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Asian Regional Debt Management Forum, hosted annually by the Asian Development Bank, provides the opportunity for debt managers from the ADB member countries to share experiences, discuss challenges, and strengthen regional cooperation in the field of public debt management. The Asian Regional Debt Management Forum 2026 is planned to be held over a period of 4-5 days, consisting of surveys and technical workshops focusing on debt management operations, challenges, and new approaches. Representatives of the Ministries of Finance, Central Banks, Debt Management Offices, and other relevant institutions of the member countries are expected to participate. Hosting this conference would bring benefits including enhancing the international reputation of the public debt management field, strengthening bilateral and regional ties with Asian member countries and international financing institutions, and promoting knowledge exchange and capacity building for debt management operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to co-host the Asian Regional Public Debt Management Forum 2026, in Sri Lanka at the end of May 2026, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the Department of Posts, Sri Lanka and the Saudi Post Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to issue two commemorative stamps based on historical places in Sri Lanka and Saudi Arabia with the aim of commemorating fifty (50) years of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries by the year 2024, further strengthening diplomatic relations between the two countries and enhancing mutual friendship among the people of the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Department of Posts, Sri Lanka and the Saudi Post Corporation for the issuance of the relevant commemorative stamps, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquiring Storage Facilities for the Medical Supplies Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Medical Supply Division, which is under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, procures and stores medicines, other medical supplies and pharmaceutical items required for patient care services and distributes to health institutions. The current storage facilities available at the Medical Supplies Division are only sufficient to store stocks for approximately 22 to 30 days of the total annual medical consumption. However, since it is currently planned to minimize the shortage of medicines by obtaining supplies for more than 06 months of all supplies in the next few months by placing orders on time and maintaining a buffer stock for a period of 03 months, there is a strong need to increase the storage capacity accordingly. As such, the proposal jointly made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to transfer 03 storage buildings, including 02 cold warehouses of 30,000 square feet each and the relevant land in Veyangoda owned by the Food Commissioner's Department, to the Ministry of Health and Mass Media for use for the relevant purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Joining the ‘Global Coalition for Social Justice’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Global Coalition for Social Justice is an international voluntary initiative dedicated to fostering cooperation among government, employer-employee organizations, financial institutions and development banks, non-governmental organizations and academic sector for promoting social justice and a decent work environment. The said institution operates under the leadership of the International Labour Organization and is a social platform that can quickly find solutions to global social justice challenges. Accordingly, it has been recognized that joining the global forum will enable to make decisions pertaining to employer-employee related issues with a comprehensive understanding of contemporary global economic and social trends as well as to strengthen worker care services, increase female labour force participation, ensure the development of workers in the informal sector, and strengthen social security measures such as employee injury insurance of public and private sector, maternity and unemployment insurance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour for the Ministry of Labour to join the Global Coalition for Social Justice’ as a partner organization on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, and for the Ministry in charge of the subject of Labour to operate as the focal point for Sri Lanka in that Coalition, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Agency (Private) Limited (SLFEA) and the Enterprise United Co-operative (ECU), Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Discussions have been held between Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Agency (Private) Limited, a subsidiary of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment, and Enterprise United Co-operative falling under the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of Japan, with regard to conducting a collaborative programme with the aim of providing internationally recognized technical and vocational training combined with education in technical subjects, Japanese language and culture to talented Sri Lankan youth with a view to increasing employment opportunities in Japan through safe, orderly and regular pathways and addressing skill shortages in Japan. A consensus has been reached to conduct the relevant training programme at the Sapugaskanda National Youth Services Council Training Centre in collaboration with the National Youth Services Council. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Agency (Private) Limited and the Enterprise United Cooperative of Japan for the relevant purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding between Universities in Sri Lanka and Foreign Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to enter into Memoranda of Understanding/Agreements between Universities in Sri Lanka and Foreign Universities/University Organizations as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.

The Project Agreement between the Alliance of National and International Science Organizations for the Belt and Road Regions and the University of Peradeniya in relation to holding the International Water Conference on Climate Change and Environmental Pollution.
The Research Collaboration Agreement and the Material Transfer Agreement between the University of Peradeniya and the Chinese University of Hong Kong of China with the objective of studying the transmission of Methicillin Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus disease among human and animal populations as well as in the environment, clarifying their antimicrobial resistance and examining genetic diversity.
The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Kelaniya and the Kyoto College of Graduate Studies for Information of Japan for achieving the objectives of enhancing academic cooperation, strengthening friendship between faculties and students through educational, professional and cultural activities and conducting joint research, conferences and seminars.
The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Vavuniya and the Indian Institute of Technology Madras, India for achieving the objectives of establishing academic and research collaboration in mutually agreed upon sectors, exchanging academic information and materials, exchanging of students and academic staff and supporting joint conferences and workshops.
The Memorandum of Understanding between the Indian Council for Cultural Relations and the University of Vavuniya for obtaining the service of visiting professors on contractual basis.

description: Consolidating the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Sector Credit Programmes under a Single Umbrella Framework and implementing Loan Schemes to assist in revival of the disaster-affected MSMEs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Over the years, the Government has implemented various concessional credit programmes to strengthen the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Sector. It has been planned to implement the RE-MSME PLUS from the year 2026 by integrating the Loan Schemes SMILE - III for investments in industrial and manufacturing sectors, E-FRIEND - II for environmentally friendly financing and the Government – funded loan scheme of re-energizing the MSME Sector (RE-MSME) for all inclusive and accessible financing for MSMEs, from among the aforesaid programmes and to implement a new loan scheme called the RE-MSME Disaster Relief Loan Scheme to revive the MSME sector affected by disaster situation. Under this, it is expected to introduce measures to provide immediate and mid-term financial support to about 130,000 entrepreneurs. Under the proposed loan scheme, action will be taken to provide the necessary funds for a period of 03 years at an interest rate of 3% per annum with a maximum grace period of 06 months, subject to a maximum of Rs. 250,000/- for micro enterprises and Rs. 1,000,000/- for small and medium enterprises. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to implement the RE-MSME PLUS Loan Scheme and the RE-MSME Disaster Relief Loan Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing assistance to the religious places affected by the disaster to clean and restore their activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided that it would be appropriate to provide relief to all religious places that have been affected by the adverse weather conditions to clean them and restore their operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to provide an allowance of Rs. 25,000/- for the cleaning and restoration of those religious places and to allocate necessary provisions for that purpose to the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Grant from the Asia Pacific Disaster Response Fund for  Post-Disaster Relief and Rehabilitation Work
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has established the Asia Pacific Disaster Response Fund on 2009-04-01 to provide incremental grant for developing member countries to restore life-preserving services immediately after disasters triggered by natural hazards, including disease outbreaks. The Government of Sri Lanka has requested the Asian Development Bank to provide funds required for the emergency response project implemented relating to the disaster caused by Cyclone Ditwah. Accordingly, the Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide a Grant of US$ 3 million under the Asia Pacific Disaster Response Fund. It is expected to supply items necessary to provide life-preserving services to the affected communities through the said Grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into the relevant Agreements with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Activation of Contingency Emergency Response Components included in the World Bank ongoing project portfolio to support Post-Disaster Recovery Needs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Intense rainfall caused by Cyclone Ditwah, one of the worst natural disasters in recent history, triggered flash floods and landslides across the country, resulting in loss of life, community displacement, destruction of livelihoods, devastation of essential public facilities as well as agricultural lands. In this backdrop, rebuilding the country must be given top priority and action should be taken within a broader framework, ranging from immediate response to long-term interventions. The international community, including bilateral and multilateral development partners, credit agencies, and non-profit organizations, has already committed or initiated immediate interventions. Accordingly, it has been deemed appropriate to activate the contingency emergency response components of ongoing projects implemented currently under the foreign funds with regard to infrastructure areas in order to rapidly rebuild damaged such infrastructure. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to activate the contingency emergency response components embedded in the investment projects funded by the World Bank Group and accordingly secure a total amount of between USD 92 to 112 million for the implementation of the proposed contingency emergency response component projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion and development of fully equipped Autism and Neurodevelopment Unit at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been decided at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21 to give priority for the establishment of a treatment center for children with autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders conforming to international standards, at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children, Colombo, in line with a budget proposal for 2025. The estimated total cost of the said project is Rs. 398.09 million, and the Department of National Planning has granted approval for the implementation of the proposed project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the project through securing the necessary funds for the implementation of the said project within the medium-term budget framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Contracts of Ground Handling Services for Sri Lankan Airlines at the Frankfurt Airport (FRA) in Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The contract of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services for Sri Lankan Airlines at the Frankfurt Airport (FRA) in Germany has expired on 2025-10-31 and the contract of the Cargo Warehouse Handling Services is due to expire on 2025-12-31. Bids have been invited following the Limited International Competitive Procurement method to select suitable service providers who have the capability of providing passenger, ramp and cargo warehouse handling services for SriLankan Airlines at that Airport. 06 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said contracts as follows, based on the recommendations of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet:to award the contract of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services to Fraport Ground Services GmbH, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, at an estimated cost of EUR 6.49, for a period of 03 years (from 2025-11-01 to 2028-10-31).to award the contract of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services to CHI Aviation Handling GmbH, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, at an estimated cost of EUR 947,766 for a period of 03 years (from 2026-01-01 to 2028-12-31).

description: Revision of the monthly allowance paid to the employees of Powerloom Enterprises, which were privatized during the period of 1980-1982, owned by the Department of Textile Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the monthly allowance being paid to employees who lost their jobs due to the privatization of the Powerloom Enterprises which were under the Department of Textile Industries and who were unable to claim for a pension due to not completing 10 years of service, is insufficient in view of the prevailing cost of living. Although the possibility of providing benefits under the Aswesuma Programme to those employees has been examined as per the Cabinet decision dated 2025-04-21, it has been found that it is not possible to provide such relief directly to them under the existing legal provisions. Therefore, the Cabinet having been informed by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development, on measures taken to revise the monthly allowance of employees receiving a monthly allowance less than Rs.5000 from among them, as Rs.5000 to be effective from 2026-01-01, as a relief for them and make payments, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet to pursue action accordingly.

description: Establishment of 2 x 50MW Wind Power Plants in Mullikulam area, Mannar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted its approval on 2025-02-10 to invite Requests for Proposals from the prospective private sector developers for the implementation of the 100 MW Mullikulam Wind Farm (50MW x 2) Project on Build, Own-Operate basis with a 20-year operational period, in line with the Government's comprehensive plan to achieve 70% of the country's electricity supply through renewable energy sources by 2030. Accordingly, Requests for Proposals have been invited for the implementation of the said project following the international competitive bidding method, and seven (7) project proponents have submitted their proposals. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the contracts for the establishment of the said two (2) 50 MW wind power facilities to Consortium of Vidullanka PLC & David Pieris Motor Company (Lanka) Limited and WindForce PLC, based on the recommendation submitted by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee after evaluating the said proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 540,000 vials of Desferrioxamine Mesylate for injection BP, 500mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for purchasing 540,000 vials of Desferrioxamine Mesylate which is used to remove excess iron from the body in anemia or thalassemia patients having blood transfusions. Two bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to ABC Pharma Services (Pvt) Ltd. (Manufacturer: Gland Pharma Limited, India), the sole responsive bidder, for a total cost of Rs. 791.1 million, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 48 Polyaxial MRI compatible (Titanium/Cobolt-Chrome) Lumber Pedicle Screws
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 48 Polyaxial MRI Compatible (Titanium/Cobalt-Chrome) Lumbar Pedicle Screws, which are used in spinal surgeries to stabilize the spine and promote fusion, deal with spinal deformities, and treat fractures and tumors and 03 bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Avenierr Pharma (Pvt) Ltd. of Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: Miraclus Orthotech (Pvt) Ltd., India) the only substantially responsive bidder for a total cost of Rs.136.32 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of vehicles for enhancing the Primary Healthcare System across the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Government of Sri Lanka has signed a Financing Agreement with the International Development Association of the World Bank Group to secure    USD 150 million under the Primary Health Care System Enhancing Project. The said project will cover all districts of Sri Lanka from 2024 to 2028, with the aim of providing health services including prevention and management of non-communicable diseases, elderly and palliative care, strengthening community-level services, and building resilience against climate-related health emergencies. A critical bottleneck identified pertaining to the project is the lack of adequate transportation facilities for field staff (Midwives, Public Health Inspectors, Primary Care Nursing Officers, and Supervisory Teams). Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to procure vehicles required to enhance the capacity of transportation to expand the coverage of home-based care and community outreach, improve the efficiency of field supervision and monitoring, and ensure the safe and timely transportation of clinical waste, as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.26 Clinical waste transport Lorries

description: Disposal of Scrap Metal of the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding method to dispose the scrap metal available with the Department of Sri Lanka Railways. Accordingly, 11 bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport Highways and Urban Development to award the tender for the disposal of scrap metal to M/s. description: Implementation of the Project on 'Natural Capital Values of Coastal and Marine Ecosystems in Sri Lanka Integrated into Sustainable Development Planning'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although many countries interested in environmental conservation have assessed and accounted the natural capital values, Sri Lanka has not yet assessed or accounted the natural capital values properly and quantitatively. Approval from the Global Environment Facility has been received for the implementation of the project proposal titled 'Integrating Natural Capital Values ​​in Coastal and Marine Ecosystems of Sri Lanka into Sustainable Development Planning' prepared by the International Union for Conservation of Nature and the Ministry of Environment, with the support of other stakeholders, under the Seventh Assistance Programme of the Global Environment Facility, taking into account the said situation. The activities of the said project have been planned to be implemented within a period of 04 years in the coastal areas identified in the districts of Galle, Mannar, Puttalam and Trincomalee, and a financial grant of USD 2.66 million is to be received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the said project using the financial grant provided by the Global Environment Facility and to sign the Memorandum of Understanding for the same between the Ministry of Environment and the International Union for Conservation of Nature, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on Sports and Youth Development between the Maldives and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Maldives and Sri Lanka have agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Sports and Youth Development between the two countries with the aim of enhancing long-term cooperation in the fields of youth development and sports development, establishing a structured framework for the same, exchange of programmes, expertise, technical knowledge and capacity building initiatives thereby empowering the youth of the two countries, developing leadership, improving sports performance and institutional cooperation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Republic of Maldives and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of a plot of land located at Perahera Mawatha, Kollupitiya, Colombo 03 belonging to the Urban Development Authority for a mixed development project on 99 year lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024-09-13, has granted approval for the disposal of a plot of land in extent of 02 roods and 23.1 perches, located at Perahera Mawatha, Kollupitiya, Colombo 03, to an investor selected to implement a mixed development project, including residential purposes. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee has recommended to cancel the leasing out of the said land due to the failure of the investor to meet the relevant transfer conditions. Similarly, the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority held on 2025-09-04 has granted approval to re-call investment proposals to dispose the said land for a suitable development purpose. Further, the Expert Committee appointed by the Cabinet regarding the disposal of the lands of the Urban Development Authority has approved the invitation of investment proposals for the use of the relevant land for hotel or commercial purposes, subject to the condition that a maximum of 50% of the land can be used for residential purposes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to invite proposals under the international competitive procurement method for the disposal of the relevant plot of land on 99-year lease basis based on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing funds from the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme  - Stage 2 Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-05-26 to negotiate with the Asian Development Bank and co-financing institutions to secure funds for the implementation of Phase 2 of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program, including the activities of completion of irrigation infrastructure facilities in the North Central Province Main Canal and the establishment of a Commercial Agriculture Development Programme with improved distribution water systems in the areas adjacent to the North Central Province Main Canal. This project will support major irrigation schemes such as Hurulu Wewa, Mannakattiya Wewa, Eru Wewa, Mahakanadarawa Wewa, Nachchaduwa Wewa, Nuwara Wewa and Thisa Wewa, and will facilitate cultivation of about 17,500 hectares. Also, the drinking water provided through the project will benefit about 175,000 families. Out of the estimated cost of USD 536.5 million for the project activities of the said project, it has been proposed to finance USD 200 million through the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to enter into a Loan Agreement with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said loan amount, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Maldives with the objective of Academic Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Republic of Maldives with a view to enhancing cooperation in the field of postgraduate education and providing training for doctors and dental surgeons of the Maldives in Sri Lanka. In addition to the health professional training programme, it is expected to obtain the assistance of the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine in Sri Lanka to recruit specialist medical practitioners required for the Maldives on a short-term or long-term basis in accordance with a separate Agreement to be entered into between the two parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Maldives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the land and the constructions of the University College, Kinniya in the Trincomalee district with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2017-06-20 to construct the University College, Kinniya in the Upparuwatta land in extent of 12 acres belonging to the Land Reform Commission in the Upparu Grama Niladhari Division of the Divisional Secretariat Division of Kinniya in the Trincomalee District. An amount of Rs.25.45 million has been spent on the constructions carried out for the college, as of now. Due to the circumstances that have arisen subsequently, the University of Vocational Technology (UNIVOTEC) has decided not to maintain the university college on that land as planned. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to halt the further construction activities of the University College, Kinniya and to vest the land allocated for the University College and its constructions with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism for the implementation of a project in the tourism sector, as proposed at the Trincomalee District Coordinating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. D.A.P. Abeysekara, a Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, who served in a Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury, has retired from the Public Service from 2025-11-13 upon the completion of 60 years of age. Accordingly, Mr. S.S. Mudalige, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, presently serving as the Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring, has been identified as suitable for the vacant post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to appoint Mr. S.S. Mudalige, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, to the vacant post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of ‘Rebuilding Sri Lanka Fund’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has faced a severe cyclone named 'Ditwa', during the last few days resulting in the loss of hundreds of lives. Further, private and public properties in large extent and infrastructure including highways, bridges, railway tracks, reservoirs, dams, irrigation systems have been severely damaged. As a result, general livelihood has been completely disrupted, and a number of rural industries including paddy cultivation and vegetable cultivation, as well as the fishing industry have been affected. A state of public emergency has been declared across the country as of now, and the affected people are staying in temporary shelters. Beyond the loss of life and property, the heavy rains and floods caused by the cyclone have disrupted services such as water supply, electricity and communication in many areas. Although, the Government is taking measures to expeditiously provide essential services to the affected people with the help of the tri-forces, police, disaster management centers and national and regional administrations, it has been found that these services are not adequate due to the severity of the damage. Although the Government has already allocated Rs.3 billion for emergency disaster relief, it seems that this amount is not sufficient to restore the damage caused to housing, infrastructure, agricultural lands, fisheries and essential services across the country. Therefore, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish a fund called the 'Rebuilding Sri Lanka Fund' as a statutory fund operating under the Presidential Secretariat, to receive contributions from donors through a dedicated bank account designated for the said purpose, and to implement a comprehensive mechanism to take necessary steps to restore the lives and livelihoods of the affected people by taking the contributions already received in the accounts of the Treasury and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as the initial capital of the proposed fund.

description: Entering into a Grant Financing Agreement with the European Union for the implementation of the ‘AgriGreen Initiative’- Green Economic Growth through Sustainable Agricultural practices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Plantations and Community Infrastructure, the Department of Rubber Development and the Rubber Research Institute have prepared a project proposal to implement AgriGreen Initiatives for green economic growth through sustainable agricultural practices in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Uva, Eastern, Southern, Central and North-Central Provinces, where rubber cultivation is widespread. The said project is expected to be implemented with a Grant of EUR 8 million from the European Union, and the (GIZ) has been selected by the European Union as the lead implementing agency. The objectives of the project are to support the transformation towards green economic growth where sustainable consumption and production practices and food security are ensured, and to catalyze a shift to more sustainable and environmentally sound agricultural practices in selected production chains, with a special focus on youth and women. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into a Grant Financing Agreement with the European Union to obtain a Grant of EUR 8 million for the implementation of the 'AgriGreen Initiative - Green Economic Growth through Sustainable Agricultural Practices' project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing urgent relief to people affected by the emergency disaster situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Considering the emergency situation that has arisen due to the adverse weather condition, the Government has declared an extended disaster emergency situation with effect from 2025‑11‑21, until further notice. The Secretary to the Treasury has issued the Budget Circular No.05/2025, with the concurrence of the National Procurement Commission, including necessary instructions to the District Secretaries and Divisional Secretaries on the methodology to be followed in the provision of emergency relief and facilities required to restore the living condition of the people affected by the said disaster situation together, and Budget Circular No.06/2025, authorizing all the Secretaries to Ministries and Chief Secretaries of Provinces to carry out necessary procurement activities without hindrance. Additional provisions amounting to Rs.550 million have already been made in addition to the provisions allocated in the budget estimates 2025 for disaster relief services and emergency response. Similarly, approval has been granted to increase the amount paid for dry rations to the families affected by the disaster from the previous amount of Rs.1,800 to Rs.3,600 per week, from Rs.2,100 to Rs.10,500, depending upon the number of family members. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to take necessary action and to provide further necessary approvals, guidelines and additional provisions for the restoration of the lives of the people disrupted by the disaster situation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Final draft of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the complex challenges and competitiveness that may arise in the future owing to the rapid urbanization, severe climatic changes, increasing consumer demand and the changes to be faced with the implementation of emerging digital technologies, approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2024‑08‑12 to publish the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment) Bill, which has been prepared to adapt to address those challenges, in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament, but, action could not be taken accordingly. Considering the need to expeditiously enact the said Bill for the efficient performance of the functions of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Regulations under section 71 of the Value Added Tax Act, No 14 of 2002 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Simplified Value Added Tax (SVAT) scheme was repealed with effect from 2025‑10‑01, and a risk-based VAT refund mechanism has been implemented to enable eligible taxpayers to refund VAT efficiently within a short period of time. Regulations may be made under section 71(4)(b) of the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, regarding the method and manner in which VAT refunds are to be made. Accordingly, the Regulations made have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2460/44 dated 2025‑10‑31. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval in terms of section 75(3) of the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although the contract for the construction of an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee had been awarded in the year 2017, the said contract has been canceled in the year 2019 owing to the poor performance of the contractor. Since the construction work of the building had been completed up to the roof at the time the contract was cancelled, it has been identified that it would be more appropriate to complete the remaining construction work as soon as possible. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement a new procurement process to select a suitable contractor to complete the said construction work of the Accident and Emergency treatment Unit at the premises of the District General Hospital, Trincomalee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Ground Handling Services and Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Shanghai Airport, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The International Air Transportation Association has published a Standard Ground Handling Agreement specifying the services required to be performed by a Ground Handling Service Provider for an airline, and Ground Handling Services mainly consist of passenger, ramp and cargo warehouse handling services. The contract for the provision of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services and the contract for the provision of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines Limited at Shanghai Airport, China are scheduled to expire on 2025-12-31 and on 2026-03-31 respectively. Bids have been invited from the licensed vendors operating at the said Airport following the limited international competitive bidding procedure for the provision of the above services. Accordingly, the following proposals made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation based on the recommendations of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, were approved by the Cabinet:

To award the contract for the provision of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services for a period of 03 years from 2026‑01‑01 to 2028‑12‑31 to China Eastern Airlines Co. Ltd., the substantially responsive sole bidder, at an estimated cost of CNY 27.929 million.
To award the contract for the provision of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for a period of 03 years from 2026‑04‑01 to 2029‑03‑31 to China Eastern Air Logistics Co. Ltd, the substantially responsive sole bidder, at an estimated cost of CNY 5.167 million

description: Awarding the procurement for the supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LP Gas) of Litro Gas Lanka Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Technical and financial bids have been invited under the two-envelop bidding procedure in accordance with the provisions of the Procurement Guidelines - 2024 for the supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LP Gas) required for Litro Gas Lanka Limited for the year 2026. Accordingly, 05 bidders have submitted bids and after technical evaluation, 02 bids have been qualified for financial bid evaluation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the procurement for supplying 380,000 MT (20%) of Liquefied Petroleum Gas to Litro Gas Lanka Limited for a period of 12 months from January 2026, to Geo Gas Trading S.A, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board pertaining to the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the E-Invoicing System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although a real-time electronic invoicing system is not operated in Sri Lanka, E-Invoicing is being widely used by many countries to modernize tax systems, reduce tax evasion and improve transparency in business transactions. Therefore, taking into account international developments in the relevant field, actions have been taken to conduct an assessment to adopt an e-invoicing framework to be compatible with the Revenue Administration Management Information System (RAMIS) implemented by the Department of Inland Revenue for tax collection. Based on the findings of the said assessment, it has been identified as appropriate to introduce a secure Web Application Programming Interface - Web API facility as an initial phase in the implementation of the E-Invoicing system. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to seek the necessary services from NCS Solutions Pvt. Limited of Singapore to enhance the Revenue Administration Management Information System (RAMIS) of the Department of Inland Revenue enabling to provide the Web API facility for VAT registered persons, was approved by the Cabinet.
